description: This file is a SOI (Source of Industry) build recipe script, specifically for managing the extraction, configuration, compilation, and installation of Linux kernel headers version 3.14 within a Yocto Project environment. It includes metadata, functions, and dependencies related to building a sanitized set of kernel headers for use by the C library.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Runs the make command to configure the kernel headers build with allnoconfig.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Placeholder function for compilation process; currently empty.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs kernel headers using make headers_install, removes the 'scsi.h' header, and cleans up conflicting install command files.
